_comment: Worked example for Financopedia. The company and all figures are INVENTED — replace every one, and replace every source and basis string with the real filing you took the figure from. The builder refuses to run if any source or basis is missing, and requires 7-12 years of history.

basis.rev_growth: Management case presented in the CIM, cross-checked against the 10-year CAGR
basis.ebitda_margin: ESTIMATE: held near FY2025, inside the 10-year range
basis.capex_pct_rev: Y1 guided; fades to the 10-year average
basis.entry_multiple: Negotiated price per the draft SPA
basis.exit_multiple: ESTIMATE: held flat to entry, the conservative convention
basis.transaction_fees_pct: Advisory fee schedule in the engagement letter
basis.financing_fees_pct: OID and arrangement fees per the commitment papers
basis.rollover_equity: Management rollover agreed in the term sheet
basis.tax_rate: FY2025 effective rate per the 10-K tax footnote
basis.cash_sweep_pct: ESTIMATE: 75% sweep per the draft credit agreement
basis.opening_cash: Cash funded to the balance sheet at close
